NOTICE OF COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE MEETING 
POSTPONEMENT 
 
 
Pursuant to the Community Charter, notice is hereby given that the 
Committee of the Whole meeting scheduled for April 11th, 2023 has been 
postponed to April 18, 2023, at 7:00 p.m. 
 
 
 
 
Marie Watmough 
Corporate Officer
